Read fresh. Both doors compute `bodyVersion ?? If-Match` and forward only a truthy token, so `expectedVersion: ''` or `false` hides a stale `If-Match`, and the update is applied. This is #13576's class on the body spelling.
- **Under the protocol-first rule (#6015; no version is named in the rule)** (REST and data door narrowing): a stale update applied today will be refused. That is **p1 + the major-in-development's `target:` label**, the same grade as #23462 and #23265 in this family.
- **Lane `domain:cli`** (`packages/rest` and `packages/runtime`, kept as mirrors on purpose).
- `finding` leaves on grading.

Claim: PM loop round 5, serial (#23492: a version token sent empty or falsy is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` on both `/data` doors, never dropped beside a stale `If-Match`) · 2026-10-14T15:03Z

Scope: the maintainer's 「当前任务处理完，后续改为串行派发」. This seat's three cards in flight at that order have all landed (PR #23490, PR #23499, PR #23500), so this is the one serial claim. It is the lane's only dispatchable p1; #23398 is `pm:blocked`.
File surface (read on `origin/main` `3a2adc8835`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, ONLY the version-token reads of `RestServer`'s `PATCH /data/:object/:id` (about `:9058`-`:9078`: `bodyVersion ?? ifMatchHeader`, then the truthy forward) and `DELETE /data/:object/:id` (about `:9141`-`:9150`: `queryVersion ?? ifMatchHeader`, then the truthy forward).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts`, ONLY the same two reads in the dispatcher's `PATCH` (`:176`-`:188`) and `DELETE` (`:215`-`:227`) branches. PR #23490 and PR #23460 made them `RestServer`'s mirrors on purpose; they stay mirrors.
- Pin files beside PR #23490's and PR #23460's (`packages/runtime/src/domains/data-{update,delete}-expected-version.test.ts`, extended, or a sibling in the same rig), and one `.changeset/23492-*.md`.
- ⛔ Not `packages/metadata-protocol` (its `#13576` guard and `normaliseVersionToken`), not `packages/spec`, not `packages/adapters/hono`, not `action-execution.ts`.

Container & model: `S`, judged (four token reads in two mirrored doors, one ruled rule, pins on an existing rig), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "no path-derived mandate"). Ceiling `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, reason: an accept-set narrowing on two released packages (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`), so one review at that tier is owed before the queue. It is served by the default model, per the maintainer's 「契约复审 opus就够了」.
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Ruling the rule rests on: #13576's maintainer decision #20 ①, 2026-08-31, as recorded at `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:2884`-`:2925` (`MalformedVersionTokenError`).
- A token shape that can never carry a version is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`.
- It is neither treated as "no token" nor answered `409`.
- The spec says the same for the quoted-empty tag (`UpdateDataRequestSchema.expectedVersion`, `protocol.zod.ts:2458`-`:2462`).
Responsibility: `the four token reads in packages/rest and packages/runtime (this lane) | the protocol's #13576 guard, which never sees a token the door drops; read, not changed | every /data update or delete that sends an empty or falsy body or query token beside If-Match`
Thread-read: 6170108252
Serial constraints cleared:
- **PR #23469 (#23429)** touches `rest-server.ts`, but only at about `:79`, `:301`, `:1852` and `:9619`-`:9717` of its base, in `RestServer`'s meta reads. None of that is the `/data` `PATCH` or `DELETE` handler (about 500 lines away). Region-disjoint; the queue arbitrates any textual conflict.
- **No other open PR** touches either file (open PRs read at 2026-10-14T15:01Z).
- **PR #23490**, the order condition, landed as `650933ec76`.
- **This seat has no other card in flight.**
